title: Bump Ward to 0.1.1 (package.json and the plugin manifest)
description: DEC-255 version ruling A: the next release is 0.1.1. scripts/check-release-tag.mjs requires the tag to equal package.json version, and test/plugin-manifest.test.ts holds the plugin manifest to the same number. Fence: those two files only. Merges last, after the six gate PRs (opum-ai/ward-cli#232 to #237).

acceptanceCriteria.text: bun run check passes, including the plugin-manifest test

implementationNotes: Correction to the description (Opus finding 1 on opum-ai/ward-cli#241): scripts/check-release-tag.mjs only checks that the tag is annotated. The tag equals package.json version check and the main-tip check are inline in .github/workflows/release.yml (the build job, lines 54 to 73). The plugin manifest number is held to package.json by test/plugin-manifest.test.ts. Evidence for the ticks, 2026-11-01: AC1: git diff --stat origin/dev...HEAD at b922061 is exactly package.json, plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and this record, both versions 0.1.1. AC2: bun run check 1152 pass, 0 fail on the merged head, CI green, and the Opus review APPROVE at b922061. The v0.1.0 profile snapshot version is 2 and v0.1.0 is the only v* tag (leader measurement), so the release notes for 0.1.1 print the snapshot bump line.
finalSummary: Bumped Ward to 0.1.1 in package.json and plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (DEC-255 version ruling A), opum-ai/ward-cli#241, Opus APPROVE at b922061. The tag, publish and visibility flip are the operator sitting.
